# Problem 1
```{r}
source("source/birthday_repeated.R")
group_sizes = 2:50

birthday_results_df = 
  expand_grid(
    number_of_people = 2:50,
    iter = 1:10000
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    repeated = map_lgl(number_of_people, birthday_repeated)
  )

birthday_results_df |> 
  group_by(number_of_people) |> 
  summarize(
    prob_of_repeat = mean(repeated) 
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = number_of_people, y = prob_of_repeat)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
```
From the plot, we obviously see that the probability of at least two people sharing a birthday increases as the number of people in the group increases. We see that the probability increases slowly for smaller group sizes but rises more rapidly as the group size approaches around 20. At approximately 23 people, the probability exceeds 50%, meaning it is more likely than not that at least two people share a birthday. By 50 people, the probability is approximately 97%.

# Problem 2
```{r}
data_files = list.files("data", full.names = TRUE)

tidy_df = tibble(
  files = data_files
) |> 
  mutate(
    data = map(files, read_csv),
    file_name = str_remove(files, "data/"),
    arm = case_when(
      str_detect(file_name, "^con") ~ "control",
      str_detect(file_name, "^exp") ~ "experimental"
    ),
    subj = str_extract(file_name, "\\d+")
  ) |> 
  select(arm, subj, data) |> 
  unnest(data) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    week_1:week_8,
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "observation",
    names_prefix = "week_"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    week = as.numeric(week),
    subj = as.numeric(subj)
  )
  
```

```{r}
tidy_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = observation, group = subj, color = arm)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(~arm)
```

The spaghetti plot shows the individual trajectories of participants in the control and experimental arms over the 8-week study period. The control group appears to remain relatively stable over time, with observations fluctuating around lower values. In contrast, the experimental group shows a clear increasing trend in observations over time.
